item.title: 6 Arrested in Crore-Worth Warehouse Robbery Case in Guwahati
item.description: GUWAHATI: Six persons have been arrested in connection with a large-scale warehouse robbery involving goods worth crores of rupees, police said on Wednesday, January 1. The operation was led by Kapil Pathak, Officer-in-Charge of Basistha Police Station. The arrests were made following a dacoity reported two days ago at an establishment in the Lokhra area of Guwahati. item.title: Assam Police Announces Major IPS Promotions
item.description: GUWAHATI: Assam Police has announced a series of key promotions for Indian Police Service (IPS) officers, effective from 1 January 2026. Officers from the 2022 batch have been promoted to the Senior Time Scale in Level 11 of the Pay Matrix, continuing in their current postings across various districts and headquarters. item.title: Major IAS Reshuffle in Assam Takes Effect, Key Officers Promoted
item.description: GUWAHATI: A major round of promotions for Indian Administrative Service (IAS) officers in Assam has been announced, effective from 1 January 2026. The promotions cover multiple levels, including the Super Time Scale, Junior Administrative Grade, Senior Time Scale, Apex Scale, Above Super Time (HAG) Scale, and Selection Grade, with pay levels and allowances as per the official Pay Matrix. item.title: New Year celebrations at Bar in Switzerland Turn Tragic as Fire Kills Around 40 and Injures Over 100
item.description: GUWAHATI: Around 40 people have died and about 115 others are injured after a fire tore through the Le Constellation bar in the Swiss ski resort of Crans-Montana during New Year celebrations. The blaze broke out at about 01:30 local time, and many of the injured suffered severe burns, with a significant number in critical condition. item.title: Guwahati Pet Shops Face Criticism Over Cruelty and Illegal Breeding
item.description: Behind the glass windows of many pet shops across Guwahati, animals wait in silence locked in small cages, deprived of proper food, clean water, and medical care. What appears to be a business of companionship, activists say, is increasingly becoming a hub of cruelty and illegal trade.
